question: Who among the following was one of the recipients of the inaugural 'Prof CR Rao Centenary Gold Medal' award in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jagdish Bhagwati**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Jagdish Bhagwati is an eminent Indian-American economist known for his extensive research in international trade and economic development.
 
• He has served as a professor at Columbia University and has been a senior fellow at the Council on Foreign Relations.
 
• Bhagwati has received several prestigious awards and honors, including the Padma Vibhushan, India’s second-highest civilian award.
 
• He has authored numerous influential books and articles that have significantly shaped modern economic policies and theories.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Prof. C.R. Rao Centenary Gold Medal**

 
 
• This award was instituted in honor of Professor Calyampudi Radhakrishna Rao, a renowned statistician whose contributions have had a profound impact on statistical theory and its applications.
 
• The award recognizes outstanding contributions to the fields of statistics and probability.
 
• It aims to promote and encourage the pursuit of excellence in research and innovation in these fields.
 
• The inaugural award in 2021 highlighted the importance of statistical sciences in various domains including economics, medicine, and social sciences.
 
 
 
• **International Trade and Economic Development**
 
 
• International trade refers to the exchange of goods and services between countries, which allows nations to expand their markets and access goods and services that may not be available domestically.
 
• Economic development involves sustained and concerted actions by policymakers and communities to improve the standard of living and economic health of a specific area.
 
• Economists like Jagdish Bhagwati have emphasized the role of free trade in promoting economic growth and development, arguing that open markets lead to more efficient resource allocation and increased innovation.
 
• Debates in this field often revolve around the balance between globalization's benefits and its potential drawbacks, such as economic inequality and environmental impact.
 
 
 
• **Columbia University**
 
 
• Founded in 1754, Columbia University is an Ivy League research university located in New York City.
 
• It is one of the world's leading institutions for higher education and research, known for its distinguished faculty and alumni, including numerous Nobel laureates and influential public figures.
 
• The university's Department of Economics is highly regarded, offering rigorous programs and fostering innovative research in various economic fields.
 
• Columbia has played a significant role in shaping modern economic thought and policy, with many of its faculty members being prominent economists.
